thread:
jordan-sales: Quick sales -> CS handoff for CoveHealth (enterprise). TL;DR: signed yesterday, 500k ARR, wants private VPC deployment + SSO (SAML) + 30d audit log retention. Currently: staging org provisioned, basic keys issued. Blockers: (1) SSO cert exchange delayed, (2) require dedicated capacity for peak inference (expected 100 rps spikes), (3) legal asked about data residency for EU patients. Renewal risk: moderate if we miss go-live window (60d). Ask CS: own onboarding, coordinate eng/support for SSO cert install, infra for dedicated pool, and get legal/KMS answers. Owners: Jordan -> sales lead, Maria -> CS lead, Sam -> eng triage, Lucas -> support SLA. Next steps enumerated below.

maria-cs: Thanks @jordan-sales. I'll own onboarding. First pass: 1) confirm SSO cert owner & contact, 2) provision Dedicated trial pool, 3) schedule kickoff with CoveHealth ops + legal. Adding owners in thread. Can you drop the SSO contact and any existing test certs? :thumbsup:

jordan-sales: SSO contact is emily@covehealth.com, says their IdP team will share certs by COB Fri. Test certs attached in the welcome bundle (link: https://files.redwood/covehealth/welcome). Note: legal asked for EU data stay in eu-1 region and KMS key in their account. Also they asked about audit log export format.

maria-cs: Got it. I'll schedule the kickoff for next Tue, propose 30m. Planning checklist: - Kickoff + owners - Provision prod-like Dedicated pool (ops ticket) - SSO cert install & SAML test - KMS key exchange + IAM checklist - Audit log export sample to legal.

sam-eng: I'll pick up dedicated sizing + infra runbook. Need answers: expected p95 latency target, seq length (typical conversation -> avg 128 tokens, some 2k spikes), model we plan to serve (open/verified?). Also: any regulatory constraints on logging redaction? I'll open ENG-4512 for triage and attach a baseline perf plan.

lucas-support: I'll own the SSO install support and post-install smoke tests. Creating SUPPORT-298 and linking to ENG-4512. ETA: resource to run the install Wed/Thu next week depending on cert arrival. We should also confirm who will rotate certs when they expire.

oncall-bot: Created JIRA tickets: ENG-4512 (Engineering triage) and SUPPORT-298 (Support SSO install). Please add any attachments to the ticket.

maria-cs: Action items I'm assigning now: - Maria: kickoff + agenda + invite CoveHealth + legal + emily (due: next Tue) - Sam: ENG-4512 (triage) + sizing proposal (due: 48h) - Lucas: SUPPORT-298 (SSO install runbook + smoke test plan) - Jordan: share welcome bundle and add emily to kickoff invite - Legal: pinged (cc'd) for KMS requirements and audit schema.

jordan-sales: Sharing welcome bundle and looping in emily now. FYI CoveHealth asked for a tentative 2-week runway to prod after certs are in. They’re sensitive to schedule for Q2 launch.

sam-eng: Quick note — for dedicated capacity we might recommend starting with 2x A100-equivalent nodes with autoscale burst to 4 for spikes. Will confirm in ENG-4512. If they require lower-cost option, suggest int8 quantized variant and capacity plan.

lucas-support: Also will validate our audit export sample meets their schema. If not, we'll propose a transform or S3 export hook.

maria-cs: Sounds good. I'll capture all of this in a runbook and post in the onboarding checklist doc. Does everyone agree we target prod readiness within 2 weeks of cert receipt?

jordan-sales: Agreed. CoveHealth incentive: small add-on credit if we hit the date. :money_with_wings:

sam-eng: Agree — depends on cert timing, but sounds feasible. I'll post updates in ENG-4512 and ping here when infra is scheduled.

lucas-support: I'll prep the install checklist and share it by EOD Friday.

maria-cs: Great — I'll send the kickoff invite and initial runbook after this thread. Thanks team :rocket:
